discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in commit a18a633: stripReasoningContent is now exported from open-sse/executors/kimchi.js and the test imports the real implementation. The duplicated helper and the misleading integration test were deleted.
Fixed in commit a18a633: wiring test now uses inst instanceof DefaultExecutor (prototype-chain check) instead of inst.constructor.name.
Fixed in commit 01ef243: registry entry is now loaded in a before() hook so a load failure surfaces as a single test failure instead of cascading as undefined across later assertions.

If your test fails because fetch was never called, `mock.calls[0]` will be `undefined`. Trying to destructure `[url]` from undefined will throw an ugly JavaScript TypeError: `undefined is not iterable`, which hides the actual reason your test failed.

Using `.toHaveBeenCalledWith()` guarantees you get a clean, readable Vitest error message saying exactly what went wrong.
I've updated this test to use expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(...). Thanks for the tip!
